parameters.query:
SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.employment_status, u.age,
       p.product_id, p.product_name, p.bank_name, p.interest_rate_min, p.interest_rate_max,
       p.min_income, p.min_credit_score, p.max_loan_amount, p.processing_fee
FROM users u
JOIN loan_products p ON
     u.monthly_income >= p.min_income
 AND u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score
 AND u.age BETWEEN p.min_age AND p.max_age
 AND (p.allowed_employment_types IS NULL OR u.employment_status = ANY(p.allowed_employment_types))
 AND p.is_active = TRUE
WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR u.batch_id = $1);
